item.tib: bka' gsang lha mo ma mo gnad kyis bskul pa
item.coloph: bka' gsang lha mo'i srog bsgrubs (sgrub) 'di/ me pho sprel lo lugs (lug) zla ba'i tshes bzang la/ mkha' 'gro dkar mo mdangs ldan gyis/ brag dkar rtse la dar dkar g.yug cing / kho bo pad ma g.yung drung la gdams pa'o/ dben gnas mdzod nag khrod du bkod pa dge legs 'phel//
